sources.title: Fine-tuning a Vision Transformer Model With a Custom Biomedical Dataset ...
sources.snippet: This guide outlines the process for fine-tuning a Vision Transformer (ViT) model on a custom biomedical dataset. It includes steps for loading and preparing the dataset, setting up image transformations for different data splits, configuring and initializing the ViT model, and defining the training process with evaluation and visualization tools.
